text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 197 units of risperidone 125mg/0.35ml 35ml syringe with 37.1 days on hand. Corvale General holds 183.91 units of risperidone with 22.9 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA drug shortage records show risperidone is not listed as in shortage as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers projected use for 23 to 37 days. Supply is not backed by a national shortage designation. Risk increases if allocation limits appear or use rises.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer monitors daily burn rate and supplier allocation notices; reports changes to Pharmacy Director for approval.
2. Pharmacy Director approves inter-hospital transfer protocol to balance days on hand between sites.
3. Buyer identifies and qualifies secondary suppliers; Pharmacy Director approves purchase agreements.
4. Pharmacy Director notifies P&T Committee if projected days on hand fall below 14 at either site.

Not recommended: No formulary changes, therapeutic substitutions, or dose restrictions at this time. Clinical decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
